viewpoint_cards.statement: Reactive lime-rich regions created by hot mixing drive later crack-water recovery.
viewpoint_cards.support_region: modern terrestrial lime-pozzolan mortar with controlled cracking and water-flow recovery
predictions: matched lime-rich specimens recover more water-flow function than controls

viewpoint_cards.statement: Hot-mixing thermal history, rather than lime-rich regions, drives the recovery behavior.
viewpoint_cards.support_region: hot-mixed mortar with a matched thermal-history comparator
predictions: thermal-history matched samples show recovery despite different lime-region abundance
falsifiers: recovery tracks lime regions after thermal history is matched

viewpoint_cards.statement: The apparent recovery is explained by sampling, preservation, or measurement variation rather than a material mechanism.
viewpoint_cards.support_region: studies with matched controls and reported measurement uncertainty
predictions: matched controls and intervention groups do not separate after measurement uncertainty
falsifiers: replicated matched groups separate on the functional endpoint

viewpoint_cards.statement: A newly admitted mechanism may explain the unresolved pattern.
viewpoint_cards.support_region: bounded by a typed admission record
predictions: a new discriminator separates the incumbent viewpoints
falsifiers: no distinct prediction or evidence basis
